title: Prompt-Induced Score Variance in Zero-Shot Binary Vision-Language Safety Classification
abstract: arXiv:2605.00326v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Safety pipelines often block content by thresholding a model's first-token unsafe score. We show that a single prompt's score is not a reliable probability and compare two repairs: mean ensemble and calibration with development labels. Across seven vision-language models and two benchmarks, an input's unsafe probability varies across 15 task-preserving rewordings with a standard deviation of 0.16-0.30 on average; the inputs that vary most are more often misclassified. The 15-prompt mean has lower negative log-likelihood (NLL) than the best single prompt, even one chosen with evaluation labels, on 13 of 14 model-benchmark pairs. Development labels change the picture: jointly selecting and calibrating a single prompt outperforms the similarly calibrated mean for all seven models on held-out data from the development benchmark. Under cross-benchmark evaluation without refitting, however, the advantage reverses, with the calibrated mean

translated_title: 零样本二元视觉-语言安全分类中由提示词引发的分数方差
translated_abstract: 安全流水线通常通过对模型首个token的不安全分数进行阈值判断来拦截内容。我们证明单一提示词得到的分数并非可靠的概率，并比较了两种修复方法：提示词均值集成与使用开发集标签进行校准。在七个视觉-语言模型和两个基准测试上，输入的不安全概率在15种保持任务不变的改写之间存在差异，平均标准差为0.16-0.30；方差最大的输入更容易被错误分类。在14个模型-基准配对中的13个上，15个提示词的均值比最佳单一提示词具有更低的负对数似然（NLL），即使该单一提示词是借助评估标签选出的。开发标签的使用改变了这一局面：在开发基准的留出数据上，联合选择并校准单一提示词在全部七个模型上都优于同样经过校准的均值方法。然而，在不重新拟合的跨基准评估中，优势发生逆转，经过校准的均值方法（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示零样本安全分类中单一提示词的不安全分数受提示词措辞影响方差大且不可靠，证明提示词均值集成在跨基准评估下更加稳健，而基于开发标签校准的单一提示词仅在开发基准上占优。
en_tdlr: Single-prompt unsafe scores in zero-shot vision-language safety classification suffer from high prompt-induced variance and unreliability; prompt-mean ensembling proves more robust under cross-benchmark evaluation, while calibrated single prompts only win on the development benchmark.
